name: Maywolf Mysteries
source:
Murder, He Borked!

Your name is Vaughn, and you're an aspiring mystery writer attending the screening of a vore fetish film starring your lovably cranky boyfriend Pascal. The mood sours once your boyfriend realizes his best scenes were cut and he storms off in a rage. Soon after, the director is found dead and your beau is the prime suspect! Is your wolf a killer? Or can you prove his innocence before the arbitrary ticking clock runs out?! It's a Maywolf Mystery, and you better not miss it!
